
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/yupi/p/19169894" title="发布于 2025-10-28 11:09">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">前后端分离，千万别再搞错了！</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2225420/202510/2225420-20251027190532587-1047329023.png" alt="前后端分离，千万别再搞错了！" class="desc_img">
        所谓全栈，就是 全干，整个网站项目的后端和前端都由你一个人负责开发。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">你是小阿巴，刚入职的全栈程序员。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761361797223-1f81129b-b633-4d1f-abce-8577402eb9bf.png"><img style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761361797223-1f81129b-b633-4d1f-abce-8577402eb9bf.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">所谓全栈，就是 <span class="md-pair-s "><span class="md-meta md-before"><strong><span class="md-plain">全干</span></strong><span class="md-meta md-after"><span class="md-plain">，整个网站项目的后端和前端都由你一个人负责开发。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">当用户打开一个网站，能直观看到、可交互操作的界面，就是前端。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761361785106-98af24aa-94c7-4519-923f-16a395e43dc7.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761361785106-98af24aa-94c7-4519-923f-16a395e43dc7.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">而当用户点击操作按钮后，触发的操作验证、数据查询、业务逻辑处理等种种 “看不到” 的操作，都由后端来完成。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761361817511-feae0750-ef8e-46ea-a1c7-ca5c5171f48c.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761361817511-feae0750-ef8e-46ea-a1c7-ca5c5171f48c.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">本文对应视频版：<span class="md-meta-i-c md-link"><span class="md-meta md-before md-meta-i"><a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1AasqzWEj5" rel="noopener nofollow"><span class="md-plain">https://bilibili.com/video/BV1AasqzWEj5</span></a></span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你使用的开发技术是比你年龄都大的 JSP，它的特点是把前端 HTML 网页代码和后端 Java 代码混在一起写。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761361861826-a3227d74-f973-45c8-8128-b55fd50eac85.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761361861826-a3227d74-f973-45c8-8128-b55fd50eac85.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">刚开始项目代码不多的时候，你写的很舒服。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">但随着项目越做越大，更多同事加入了这个项目的开发，你也渐渐发现了几个问题。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761361885029-6b2c73b3-0258-44ef-892e-3fcc92ca1bdc.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761361885029-6b2c73b3-0258-44ef-892e-3fcc92ca1bdc.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<ol class="ol-list" start="">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">代码混乱难维护：前端后端代码纠缠在一起，不利于阅读，也不利于排查 Bug。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">团队协作困难：你在改前端样式，同事在改后端逻辑，经常改着改着就冲突了。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">人员要求更高：开发人员必须同时学习前端和后端技术，今天写 CSS 调样式，明天写 SQL 查数据库，根本忙不过来。</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">部署效率低下：由于前端后端写在一起，哪怕改个按钮颜色都要重新编译部署整个项目。</span></p>
</li>
</ol>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761361917376-34ce0b99-b1ee-49f4-b1be-4d78a5546f55.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761361917376-34ce0b99-b1ee-49f4-b1be-4d78a5546f55.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">受这些问题的影响，项目开发效率越来越低，Bug 却越来越多，你压力山大、发如雨下。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761361956774-37813a66-87c3-4fa2-8fbe-bfc4fd04d7e2.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761361956774-37813a66-87c3-4fa2-8fbe-bfc4fd04d7e2.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">老板看出了你毛儿的不易，给公司请来了一位新的技术导师，号称 “全栈冤种” 的鱼皮。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮看了看你的项目，摇了摇头：连前后端分离都不做么？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你疑惑地问：前后端分离？没听说过。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">这时，你的同事阿土申插嘴道：我知道啊！我们现在把前端静态文件放在 static 文件夹，JSP 代码放在 jsp 文件夹，这不就是前后端分离吗？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761361989824-bac60750-c07e-4587-911a-e1ebcb6050c3.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761361989824-bac60750-c07e-4587-911a-e1ebcb6050c3.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮皱眉：那只是文件夹分离，不是真正的前后端分离。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">阿土申不服：鱼皮老狗，那你说说用什么技术才算是前后端分离？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮笑道：前后端分离可不是某种特定的技术，而是一种 <span class="md-pair-s "><span class="md-meta md-before"><strong><span class="md-plain">架构</span></strong><span class="md-meta md-after"><span class="md-plain"> 思想。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">看看你们现在的项目，用户访问网站时，是由后端服务器接收请求，然后在后端查询数据并拼接到 HTML 网页模板中，生成完整的网页，最后再返回给用户。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761362010613-c0a8e884-4a68-4592-a160-6dbcb9c5836a.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761362010613-c0a8e884-4a68-4592-a160-6dbcb9c5836a.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">显然，后端承受了太多！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">而如果改造为前后端分离：</span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">前端专注于用户界面的呈现和交互逻辑</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">后端专注于数据处理和业务逻辑，不涉及界面代码和网页生成</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">用户在前端进行操作时，前端通过 <span class="md-pair-s "><span class="md-meta md-before"><strong><span class="md-plain">API 接口</span></strong><span class="md-meta md-after"><span class="md-plain"> 向后端发送请求，由后端处理操作并返回数据给前端，由前端完成数据的最终展示。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761362046509-e2c35e3d-438c-410a-a395-6d03dbc3f8dd.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761362046509-e2c35e3d-438c-410a-a395-6d03dbc3f8dd.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你不明觉厉：可是这样做有什么好处呢？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮指着你之前列出的问题说：前后端分离就是专门解决这些痛点的！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">1）首先是 <span class="md-pair-s "><span class="md-meta md-before"><strong><span class="md-plain">代码分离</span></strong><span class="md-meta md-after"><span class="md-plain">：将前端代码和后端代码完全分开，最好是 2 个独立的项目</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">2）代码分离后，就可以 <span class="md-pair-s "><span class="md-meta md-before"><strong><span class="md-plain">开发分离</span></strong><span class="md-meta md-after"><span class="md-plain">：前端和后端程序员可以同时干活，互不干扰。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">3）还可以 <span class="md-pair-s "><span class="md-meta md-before"><strong><span class="md-plain">部署分离</span></strong><span class="md-meta md-after"><span class="md-plain">：前端和后端项目各自独立部署，后端出了问题或者修改了逻辑，不用重新部署前端。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761362086520-2f37bdeb-48d9-4255-8c8f-d33a64a03b26.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761362086520-2f37bdeb-48d9-4255-8c8f-d33a64a03b26.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">4）做到前面 3 个分离后，我们便能实现前后端分离的本质 —— <span class="md-pair-s "><span class="md-meta md-before"><strong><span class="md-plain">职责分离</span></strong><span class="md-meta md-after"><span class="md-plain">，专业的人干专业的事情，各自发挥特长，整体效率自然更高。当然最主要的是，后端出了问题，前端不用背锅。 </span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761362105495-f01344df-f4a7-4aff-8ae0-a6d72f498e91.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761362105495-f01344df-f4a7-4aff-8ae0-a6d72f498e91.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">听着鱼皮滔滔不绝，你双眼放光：前后端分离这么厉害，是不是还能提升网站性能呢？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮摇摇头：不一定，而且有时前后端分离可能更慢！因为用户访问网站时，浏览器需要先加载前端页面，然后执行 JavaScript 脚本请求后端数据，这比传统的后端直接返回完整页面多了一次网络请求。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761362143081-9439df87-b695-4927-a507-67424da7a67b.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761362143081-9439df87-b695-4927-a507-67424da7a67b.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">但是也别灰心，前后端分离后，前端和后端都可以分别进行优化，更灵活。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761362178653-5f518d3a-7ae1-4c20-b4fa-fc16d6c6df67.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761362178653-5f518d3a-7ae1-4c20-b4fa-fc16d6c6df67.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你点了点头：原来如此，看来前后端分离的主要目的是 <span class="md-pair-s "><span class="md-meta md-before"><strong><span class="md-plain">提升开发效率和代码维护性</span></strong><span class="md-meta md-after"><span class="md-plain">，而不是提升性能。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">于是你带领团队开始重构项目，前端用 React 框架重写了整个界面，打包成静态文件部署到 CDN 加速网络上；后端则专门提供 API 接口，返回 JSON 数据，部署在独立的服务器上，互不影响。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761362217227-a16ab51e-189e-4d98-90c0-57658b4d05be.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761362217227-a16ab51e-189e-4d98-90c0-57658b4d05be.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">几个月后，你感受到了前后端分离的优势：</span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">团队成员各司其职</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">前端技术灵活选择</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">后端服务多端复用</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761362236749-fecdad5b-8a38-4ea0-9788-7f77cb923706.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761362236749-fecdad5b-8a38-4ea0-9788-7f77cb923706.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">虽然前端和后端对接的过程中偶尔会斗嘴打架，但你也通过自己总结的一套前后端分离的实战经验完美解决。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761362317673-3ab69724-654a-4f79-bdd7-953e3132b682.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761362317673-3ab69724-654a-4f79-bdd7-953e3132b682.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你兴奋地对鱼皮说：前后端分离也太爽了吧！</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮笑着问：那我问你，前后端分离一定比不分离更好么？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你不假思索：那当然了！你看看这盛世岂不如你所愿？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-image md-img-loaded" data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761362356008-667d0a83-3e6b-4b61-9009-d21568e6ce46.png"><img data-src="https://pic.yupi.icu/1/1761362356008-667d0a83-3e6b-4b61-9009-d21568e6ce46.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮摇摇头：小阿巴你要记住，没有最好的架构，只有相对更合适的架构！是否采用前后端分离，要根据团队项目规模、项目实际需求、团队技术能力等综合决定。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你：我明白了，抛开实际场景谈架构都是耍流氓~</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">鱼皮：最后问个问题，用了 React 框架一定就是前后端分离么？</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">朋友，说说你的看法吧。</span></p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
